changes.comment: Dreamux now registers Channel-served Commands. Each dispatcher registers its Channels' catalogs as one atomic batch and serves them from the existing Command registry under channel.<encoded channel_id>.<local_name>, where the host percent-encodes the dispatcher-local channel id, over the same admin socket and in-process adapters as built-in Commands. A Command whose Channel has not finished starting, or has begun stopping, is refused as retryable CHANNEL_COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE rather than as an unknown method. dispatcher status now also reports each configured Channel's registered Command names, declared identity, and lifecycle state, and never any Channel configuration value.
